Kill [[Amalek the Unmerciful]].

==Quest information==

===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Amalek the Unmerciful]] in [[Watchtower Coast (War in Kryta)|Watchtower Coast]]
* *BONUS* Kill Amalek the Unmerciful in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 750 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 10 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 5 War Supplies

== Walkthrough ==

Start from [[Divinity Coast (outpost)|Divinity Coast]] and follow the map towards the second clearing and head up the slope to your left, towards the [[resurrection shrine]], i.e. do not follow the road. (If you have trouble using the keyboard to navigate the route, click at the top of the incline, near the shrine, leaving it to the game's pathfinding [[AI]].)

After the shrine, keep to your left, heading north and counter-clockwise to reach Amalek due north, but around the corner from the shrine. The number of groups you encounter along the way depend on several factors: which [[foe]]s spawn, their party composition, and how close to each other. Amalek's group is easy enough to defeat on its own, although the boss does bring condition and hex removal that can slow you down.

However, the difficulty in reaching Amalek ranges from trivial to among the most difficult routes of all 21 of the Shining Blade bounties. Since the  Mantle and Peacekeepers are hostile to the [[Tengu]], Mergoyle, and Bog Skale, you can sometimes find only a few foes to mop up. In rare situations, a Mergoyle boss group will spawn close to Amalek and defeat him before you get close (allowing you to immediately return to [[Lion's Arch Keep]] for your reward); the only indication of this is when you receive the [[morale boost]] and your quest log updates.

In contrast, you can also end up with up to four groups of Mantle/Peacekeepers before reaching your target. The first group (located just after the resurrection shrine) is small and presents no trouble. However, the remaining full-strength groups typically overlap and can [[wipe]] even a well-balanced party. The second group is stationary, on the northeast corner of the bluffs (before you have to turn west); they can be pulled south, away from the remaining groups. The third group walks a tight-patrol path on the slope between the second group and the edge of Amalek's protective zone; you can pull them east (to the second group's original location). The fourth group is a patrol; you can avoid them with careful timing, although some find it  safer to pull them south so that they do not combine forces with Amalek's team.

The allies of Kryta who exact lethal justice on Amalek will receive both gratitude and a reward from Queen Salma."''
